acceptance: The four counterexamples keep their original row counts (rewrite does not fire) with executed DuckDB tests; the Q17 variant 4 dead-leg shape still rewrites.

description: Adversarial review M8: drop_literal_row_source (compat.py:246-293) does not check that the inner SELECT has no FROM/WHERE/LIMIT. DuckDB: SELECT 0 AS r FROM (SELECT 1 FROM t) d (3 rows) -> 1 row; (SELECT 1 WHERE FALSE) d -> 1 row instead of 0; LIMIT 0 -> 1 row; COUNT(*) over it -> 1 instead of 3. Guard: inner select must have no FROM, WHERE, LIMIT, GROUP/HAVING/distinct/set-op; add the four counterexamples as executed tests. Fix before D4 uses it.
